newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanese deputies want new term for Hariri.
newsitem.headline: Lebanese deputies want new term for Hariri.

text.p: Some 101 of Lebanon's 128 parliamentary deputies want Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri reappointed to a third term of office, deputies said on Thursday.
The final count of deputies consulted by President Elias Hrawi made Hariri's reappointment later on Thursday appear inevitable.
Hrawi must nominate as prime minister the choice of the majority of parliamentary deputies.

Hrawi, who completed his consultations before lunch, was expected to make the nomination in the late afternoon before the arrival of French President Jacques Chirac who is visiting Lebanon on a Middle East tour.
Hariri has held office since October 1992. He routinely stepped down last week after parliamentary elections to allow the new parliament to choose a prime minister.
